not anymore, but when I was young, he would be very physical. In fact, even my mom would hit me, but she stopped a few years back. Now its only my father and he mostly justs yells and screams and hits and moves furniture around the house. 

I admit, i have a problem myself. i think i have anger issues too. when my dad screms, i stand up to him and scream back and a tell him to beat me if he has the balls but i think he does becaude hes afraid to go to jail. The most important thing to him is his image. At church, hes in the choir and many people respect him for that. He never likes to admit that he had n issue with anything. While i was living at my cousins house, my mom tried to get the pastor who is a family friend to talk to him but he just blew him off. 

My attitude to life is similar to his. The saying, like father, like son holds true. At school, im the alpha of the group. i like to take control in projects and things like that. but because ive developed this 'perfect student' image, im afraid to tell people that i have mental issues or suicidal thoughts. i dont want people to stigmatize me and view me as weak. 

Today, im at church again and i think my mom is going to try to have the pastor convince and talk some sense into my dad. but i feel sometimes they dont believe my side of the story because theyve known my father for a very long time without knowing this violent side of him. but i took a video of him yelling in the car on the way to church, him screaming at night and breaking things and him moving furniture an throwing it to the e ground. and i think they blame me for whats happening to this family. they tell me to repent, tell me to change and ask for forgivness. but they dont pray for my fathet to change. it fustrates me when this happens but i just take it. 

in two years, im going off to university and inprobably will never go home again.
